description: The pie chart represents the distribution of task types across turns from verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations. There are three task types shown: Article generation, Article editing, and Headline generation. Article generation accounts for the largest portion, making up 82.9% of the tasks. Article editing is the second most common task, comprising 14.6% of the total. Headline generation is the least common task, making up only 2.4% of the total. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the chart. The segments are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
